summary.name: Flow Studio
summary.one_liner: Flow Studio is an AI video generator that turns a text idea into a short movie of up to 3 minutes with plot, music, sound effects and voices.
use_cases: turn a story idea into a short movie
make an AI horror or romance clip
create a video with a favorite movie or anime character
produce short comedy videos without editing
summary.what_it_does: Flow Studio generates short videos of up to 3 minutes from a text idea, including plot, background music, sound effects, dialogue and character voices. It says the selected actor stays consistent throughout the video and that music and sound are matched to the plot. Users can pick from a large library of characters (anime, movie characters) or create their own original character. Video types mentioned include horror, romantic and standup comedy, with more said to be coming. The page presents this as a one-click process requiring no post-production editing.
notable: Character consistency across the whole video
Automatic music, sound effects and voice matching to the plot
Millions of selectable characters plus user-created characters
Up to 3-minute videos generated in one click
caveats: Page does not state pricing or whether it is free to use, despite the 'free' tag in the listing
Page text is mostly promotional; output quality and limits are not independently described
